description.en: Application ID, created and queried through the console. Only a single ID is supported.
Page number. By default, page 1 is queried.
Number of entries per page. The default value is 10.

descriptions.zh:
### 使用说明
本接口用于查看 RTC 3.0 的应用推流模板列表。
### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
### How-To  
This API is used to view the list of stream ingest templates for an RTC 3.0 application.  
### Queries per second (QPS) limit  
The QPS limit for this API is 10 queries per second per user. If this limit is exceeded, API calls will be rate-limited, which may impact your business. Please invoke the API appropriately.
